card.text: Explore Saturn in 3D with cssEarth. Orbit its spectacular rings, discover its moons, and browse scientific facts about this gas giant.

introduction.text: The sixth planet from the Sun, Saturn is a vast gas giant surrounded by spectacular rings made of countless pieces of ice and rock.

normal.title: Visible-light mosaic
normal.summary: Cloud bands are assembled from archival visible-light observations. The mosaic does not depict conditions at the scene date.

ultraviolet.title: OPAL F225W map
ultraviolet.summary: The 225 nm observations date to August 2025. Filled rows and added visible-light detail are not ultraviolet measurements.

methane.title: OPAL FQ889N map
methane.summary: The 889 nm observations include filled rows and added visible detail. Brightness does not measure methane concentration.

thermal.title: Thermal-style cloud illustration
thermal.summary: Visible cloud patterns are recolored to suggest a thermal view. The colors do not measure temperature or infrared brightness.

cross-section.title: Interior structure model
cross-section.summary: Colored layers distinguish the inferred interior structure. Their boundaries illustrate a model, not a measured interior map.
